name: Folio Studio
description: A local art portfolio editor with static site export and Cloudflare Pages publishing.

history.title: Lean Astro exports
history.description: Remove editor metadata, unused block CSS and unselected material effects from published pages. Static sites emit no JavaScript; animation and sketchbook runtime files are generated only when used.

history.title: Layered free layout and separate mobile canvas
history.description: Arrange overlapping text and image layers directly on a prominent free canvas, resize and reorder layers, configure independent mobile positions, and automatically stack incomplete phone layouts.

history.title: Media deletion and File Explorer
history.description: Delete an image and its placements with local file recovery in the Windows Recycle Bin, or open File Explorer with the original upload selected. Other edited versions are preserved.

history.title: Visible block deletion and undo
history.description: Delete blocks directly from the canvas toolbar or Pages list, and restore up to 20 recent deletions during the editor session.

history.title: Animated coming-soon splash
history.description: Editable full-screen landing layout with procedural watercolor paper, slow light and ink blooms, plus a reusable coming-soon portfolio example.

history.title: About, feature history and library credits
history.description: Feature additions with linked commits, library-to-feature attributions, searchable dependency credits, and shared content synchronized with the README.

history.title: Performance and responsive layouts
history.description: Incremental canvas previews, responsive image derivatives, background image processing, smaller exported scripts, and narrow-screen editor layouts.

history.title: Paper and ink materials
history.description: Procedural paper grain, fibers and weave, moving light, heading ink finishes, and pigment washes with motion preferences respected.

history.title: Media library and image editing
history.description: Import and organize artwork, preserve originals and edited versions, crop, resize, rotate, adjust color, remove connected backgrounds, and refine transparency with brushes.

history.title: Workspace appearance
history.description: Minimal monochrome editor typography with optional icons and movable stickers stored locally in the browser.

history.title: Themes and inherited block styles
history.description: Six gallery-inspired presets and editable site defaults for fonts, colors, sizing, spacing and artwork layout, with individual block overrides.

history.title: Grouped block library
history.description: 25 portfolio blocks across Text, Artwork, Media, Links & contact, and Layout, with search and collapsible groups.

history.title: Plain interface copy
history.description: Removed promotional slogans from the editor and portfolio defaults.

history.title: Editing directly on the canvas
history.description: Editable headings, paragraphs and captions, photo drops, existing artwork assignment, and drag handles for image sizing.

history.title: Live preview and block drops
history.description: Preview updates as content changes; blocks can be dragged onto the page and reordered.

history.title: Initial portfolio builder
history.description: Local Python launcher, pages and artwork blocks, page-flipping sketchbooks, Astro builds, and configured Cloudflare Pages publishing.

libraries.name: Astro
libraries.detail: Compiles the saved portfolio into static HTML, CSS and small interaction scripts when Build site or Publish is used. Runs locally during builds.

libraries.name: StPageFlip
libraries.detail: Turns HTML sketchbook pages with mouse/touch interaction, hard/soft pages and portrait layouts. Used in the editor preview and exported sketchbook pages.

libraries.name: Cropper.js
libraries.detail: Provides movable selections and aspect-ratio crop controls in the local image editor. Not shipped in portfolio pages.

libraries.name: Pica
libraries.detail: Resamples artwork when pixel dimensions are changed in the local image editor. Does not send images to an external service.

libraries.name: Magic Wand Tool
libraries.detail: Selects connected pixels by color tolerance so the editor can remove their alpha. Runs in a local worker; this is color selection rather than AI subject segmentation.

libraries.name: Pillow
libraries.detail: The Python server corrects orientation, removes metadata, preserves transparency, and creates thumbnail, responsive and full-size WebP copies. The original upload is preserved. Pillow's codec notices are documented upstream.

libraries.name: python-dotenv
libraries.detail: Reads optional .env publishing settings and removes imported Cloudflare entries after Windows-encrypted storage is verified. Credentials stay outside portfolio content and generated pages.

libraries.name: Wrangler
libraries.detail: Uploads the built static site to the configured Pages project using the Cloudflare API. Invoked by the Python server when Publish is selected.

implementationNote: Canvas text editing, block drag-and-drop, adjustment sliders, erase/restore brushes, workspace decorations, and procedural paper/ink use Folio Studio code with native browser APIs. No separate material or AI segmentation library is incorporated. System fonts need no font service. File Explorer selection and Recycle Bin operations use native Windows shell APIs with no additional library. Cloudflare settings use native Windows current-user DPAPI encryption. The installer downloads private official Python and Node runtimes and installs pnpm; no additional encryption library is used.
inventoryNote: The expandable inventory lists installed JavaScript packages, including indirect build and publishing dependencies. These packages support the direct libraries above; they are not all delivered to visitors. Versions and declared licenses come from installed package metadata. Package license files and upstream notices remain authoritative. Python dependency ranges come from requirements.txt.
